name: Elune's Grace
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Time's a wastin', lad. It's time for you to return home to Darnassus. Priestess Alathea's sent word here that you're to return there for training. Seems they feel you're ready to be tested much like those who serve the Light. You should head out whenever you can. Alathea's message said that she'd be waitin' for you in the Temple of the Moon. Good luck.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText: Elune bless you for returning so quickly to us. This is an important time in your training, and a time that all of our order take very seriously. When you've rested from your journey here, please, let me know. We can then discuss the continuation of your training and where your path will lead you next.
